formulaDesignRationale: Fewer inputs with larger weights preserve input variance better than many diluted weights. Weights sum to 1.0 for interpretability. High-variance stats (brightness std=17.46, tension std=21.82, warmth=16.8, intimacy=16.11) are used as primary inputs. Clamp range [5,95] avoids absolute extremes while allowing full spread.

proposed_rules.rule_1_hard_contradiction: Mark needsStatReview=true if acousticness>=75 AND electronicness>=75, OR intimacy>=80 AND socialEnergy>=80, OR energy>=80 AND motion<=20
proposed_rules.rule_2_vocal_anomaly: Mark needsStatReview=true if genre in {pop, rnb-soul} AND vocalPresence<30, OR genre in {ambient-dream} AND vocalPresence>85
proposed_rules.rule_3_large_affinity_change: Mark needsStatReview=true if any season/weather dim changed >20 points from original AND statConfidence<0.75
proposed_rules.rule_4_high_impact_low_confidence: Mark needsStatReview=true if track appears in top-50 avg rank across profiles AND statConfidence<0.75
proposed_rules.rule_5_undetected_contradiction: Mark needsStatReview=true for any hard-contradiction track currently marked needsStatReview=false

thresholds.hard_contradiction: >=75/>=75 for acou+elec, >=80/>=80 for inti+social, >=80/<=20 for energy+motion
